title: Jack and the Long Lines in the Field
synopsis: Jack notices the rake collecting almost-dry hay into long windrows while Molly makes a maze of imaginary paths.
continuity_state: Before: The mown field has been fluffed with a tedder and allowed more drying time. Hay is not yet baled. After: Farmer Ruth has raked the nearly dry cut grass into long windrows on a later dry day; the field is ready for further moisture checks and future baling. Jack adds before-and-after drawings of scattered grass and rows.
